title: Open a new glue tube: unscrew the cap, turn it over, push its point through the nozzle's seal and screw it back on
instruction: Open this new tube of glue so it is ready to use, then put its cap back on.
context: Glue, ointment and paint tubes are sold with the nozzle sealed by a thin membrane, opened with the point on top of the cap: unscrew it, turn it over, push the point squarely into a 4.5 mm opening, then turn the cap back over and screw it down. The 15 mm cap must be regripped twice and its point centred within about 2 mm; pressing on the soft tube pushes glue out.
setup: A pine block 50 x 90 x 30 mm (fixed) with a 3 mm saw kerf along y, centred at x 0.30 m, y -0.12 m, stands in for the hand holding the tube. In it stands a new 30 ml aluminium tube (25 mm across, 100 mm long, 40 g), its folded end 20 mm down in the kerf: M11 neck 9 mm tall, 4.5 mm orifice closed by the tube's aluminium membrane 0.5 mm below the rim. White ribbed polypropylene cap, 15 mm across, 11.5 mm tall, 2 g, with a 5 mm piercing point on its top, screwed down. Distractors (scoring ignores them): a ceramic mug (114 x 90 x 80 mm, 300 g) at (0.20, 0.10), a roll of clear tape (100 mm across, 50 mm tall, 60 g) at (0.42, 0.06) and a paper notebook (229 x 170 x 10 mm, 120 g) at (0.16, 0.27). Positions are object centres on the table, x forward from the arms' bases, y to the left, metres.
scoring: 0 if a gripper squeezes the tube's body (fingers on opposite sides of it, each within 4 mm of its surface, for 0.25 s; in real trials a dent in the body or glue outside the nozzle) at any time. Otherwise: 1.0 when the membrane is pierced and the cap is screwed back down to within a quarter turn of fully down, with every fingertip at least 3 cm from the cap, held 2 s; 0.75 if pierced and the cap is back on the thread; 0.5 if pierced; 0.25 if the cap has come off the thread; 0 otherwise.
reset_notes: Each trial uses a new, factory-sealed tube (the membrane cannot be restored), filled with an inert gel instead of glue. Screw its cap fully down and push the folded end 20 mm into the kerf.
fidelity: Tube, cap and holder are custom meshes at real size; distractors are SimReady props. The tube is rigid and fixed in its holder; squeezing is a fingertip-position proxy. The thread is a step hook: on the thread the cap is held to the neck's axis at 1.5 mm per turn, off after 1.5 turns, and a cap set on the neck within 2.5 mm of its axis takes the thread up when turned clockwise. The membrane is a sprung disc (5,000 N/m) that tears at 2 mm, 10 N (estimate). Uniform rubber-like friction.
